_comment: Pinned public images for the MCP servers that need no local build -- the two that do (kubernetes-mcp-oci, backstage-mcp-server) are tracked by their own Dockerfiles instead. gitlab is deliberately absent: it's retired (see README.md), superseded by a first-party connector, and the container must not be stood back up. Tracked by the customManagers.docker entry in renovate.json. Bumping a tag here does not, by itself, update ~/.claude.json or the running container -- see README.md.
